readings: OR together the next-state bits from every active state's transition (next_state may have multiple bits set).
Arbitrate between active states (e.g., lowest or highest index) to produce a single one-hot next_state.

Use the outputs of a single arbitration-selected active state (e.g., lowest index) and ignore others.

Treat as invalid/reset-like and force next_state[0]=1 (S0).
